format: Flowing Fists (FLO; v155, name v157.1): the English set from Japan's Aura Seeker, revealed at Worlds 2026. The cards shown so far. Regulation mark J = Standard.

abilities.name: Mega Protection
abilities.text: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Mega Evolution Pokémon ex.

attacks.name: Power Cyclone
attacks.text: Move an Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

abilities.name: Aura Seeker
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may use this Ability. Search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Dancing Fist
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon ex, this attack does 120 more damage.
